test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

My knowledge about archeology is __very less__ in comparison to my sister.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**A drop in the ocean**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The expression "**a drop in the ocean**" is an idiomatic phrase used to convey that something is an extremely tiny or insignificant part of a much larger whole.
 
• It suggests that whatever is being referred to is so small or unimportant that it has little or no impact in the context of the larger situation.
 
• In the given sentence, "*the speaker's knowledge about archaeology is a drop in the ocean compared to their sister's,*" it means that the speaker's level of knowledge or understanding of archaeology is very minimal and insignificant when compared to their sister's expertise or knowledge in the same field.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**A spit in the ocean**", also means a very small amount.
 
• "**A fish out of water**", means someone who is uncomfortable or out of place in a particular situation.
 
• "**Water under the bridge**", means something that has happened in the past and cannot be changed.
